startGiftDay.title: Start gift day now?
startGiftDay.description: Gift day starts for everyone right away, without waiting for the date.

points.order: The unwrap order is shuffled, because nobody has yet.
points.open: Dibs!, tips and questions stay open until the end of the day. Then it's done.
points.secret: Who drew whom stays secret, unless you reveal the Santas.

finishGiftDay.title: Finish gift day now?
finishGiftDay.description: This Secret Santa is over for everyone, without waiting for tomorrow.

points.closed: Dibs!, tips, questions and the settings close.
points.received: Everyone can tick off what they got.
points.next: You can start a new edition.
points.undo: Changed your mind? Reopen gift day from this menu.

backToShopping.underway: Not once something's unwrapped or revealed
backToShopping.title: Back to shopping?
backToShopping.description: Gift day stops: everyone shops for their giftee again, until the new gift day.

points.date: Gift day moves to the date you pick below. Reminders follow it.
points.order: The unwrap order stays a surprise; the unwrapping starts over.
points.secret: Nothing has been unwrapped or revealed, so nobody learns anything.

backToShopping.date-help: After today. You can still change it in the settings.

reopenGiftDay.title: Reopen gift day for today?
reopenGiftDay.description: For corrections: it's gift day again until the end of today, {today}. Then it's over again.

points.open: Dibs!, tips, questions, the unwrap order and the settings open again.
points.date: The gift day date becomes today.
points.secret: Whether the Santas are revealed stays as it is.

newEdition.title: Start a new edition?
newEdition.description: A draft with the same people and budget as {title}, without dates. Nothing is sent until you open it.
newEdition.finish: {title} is finished first, as only one runs at a time: gift day is over and Dibs!, tips, questions and its settings close.
newEdition.name: Name

errors.GIFT_DAY_UNDERWAY: Something has been unwrapped or revealed already, so it can't go back.
errors.EDITION_CLOSED: Only the latest edition can be reopened.
errors.EDITION_CHANGED: Someone changed this edition just now. Reload the page and try again.
errors.EDITION_IN_PROGRESS: There's already an edition that hasn't been drawn yet.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
